SCHTEACH.PEDINN:
Physician Assistant Program

It was my first year to co-teach this course last year. I am co-teaching this course with Dr. Paul Yeh again and we decided to restructure this course. We both worked together to come up with new ideas to help the students learn how to study for the PANCE. We have included the students in the process by flipping the classroom. We have 76 students and every week 6 students will research and present a Powerpoint teach their peers from topics that they have chosen and feel confident about. Every week a different system will be introduced. We have cases and explanation within the course. We also have included the students in the question writing process so that they may learn how the questions are written on the PANCE so they may anticipate what type of question are being asked. We will be grading the 6 PowerPoints submitted by the Module Leaders and 3 submitted questions from the Student Learners, who did not submit a powerpoint for the week. The students also have an assignment for submitting suggestions to a group Discussion Board which we will be grading as well. We believe this will encourage the students to study for the PANCE as a group and learn from each other and stay engaged in a virtual setting. Other resources will be Rosh Review, last year's system cases with explanations, weekly quizzes and End of Curriculum exam which they have to pass to graduate.
